kpiid-login-button: Label of the button on Special:UserLogin that starts the sign-in through KPI ID, the university's single sign-on.
kpiid-not-authorized:
Shown on Special:UserLogin instead of {{msg-mw|pluggableauth-not-authorized}} when KPI ID confirmed the person but no wiki account holds their EMPLOYEE_ID.

Parameters:
* $1 – unused; the name PluggableAuth would have used
kpiid-loginreqpagetext:
Shown instead of {{msg-mw|loginreqpagetext}} to a reader who is not signed in, while KPI ID sign-in is configured. Keep the
element and its attributes: KPI ID's button script replaces it with the sign-in button. Translate only the sentence and set data-locale to uk or en, the languages the button has. Parameters: * $1 – link to [[Special:UserLogin]] with the text {{msg-mw|loginreqlink}}, shown where the button script does not load * $2 – URL of [[Special:UserLogin]] with the page to return to
kpiidaccounts:
{{doc-special|KpiIdAccounts}}
Title of Special:KpiIdAccounts, which lists the accounts linked to an EMPLOYEE_ID and creates or links accounts.
kpiidaccounts-summary: Intro text at the top of Special:KpiIdAccounts.
kpiidaccounts-legend: Legend of the form on Special:KpiIdAccounts.
kpiidaccounts-employeeid: Label of the EMPLOYEE_ID field and the heading of its column. EMPLOYEE_ID is the staff identifier KPI ID sends; keep it untranslated.
kpiidaccounts-username:
Label of the username field and the heading of its column.
{{Identical|Username}}
kpiidaccounts-realname:
Label of the optional real name field and the heading of its column.
{{Identical|Real name}}
kpiidaccounts-email:
Label of the optional email field and the heading of its column.
{{Identical|Email}}
kpiidaccounts-existing: Label of the checkbox that links an existing account instead of creating one.
kpiidaccounts-created:
Shown after an account was created.

Parameters:
* $1 – the username
kpiidaccounts-linked:
Shown after an existing account was linked.

Parameters:
* $1 – the username
kpiidaccounts-unlinked:
Shown after a link was removed.

Parameters:
* $1 – the username
kpiidaccounts-list: Heading above the table of linked accounts.
kpiidaccounts-list-count:
Number of linked accounts, above the table.

Parameters:
* $1 – the number
kpiidaccounts-list-empty: Shown instead of the table when no account is linked.
kpiidaccounts-unlink: Button in each row of the table that removes the account's EMPLOYEE_ID.
kpiidaccounts-error-employeeid: Error: the EMPLOYEE_ID is empty, has spaces or is too long.
kpiidaccounts-error-employeeid-taken:
Error: another account holds the EMPLOYEE_ID.

Parameters:
* $1 – the EMPLOYEE_ID
* $2 – the username of the account that holds it
kpiidaccounts-error-username:
Error: the text is not a valid username.

Parameters:
* $1 – the text
kpiidaccounts-error-username-exists:
Error: an account with this name exists and the checkbox {{msg-mw|kpiidaccounts-existing}} is not ticked.

Parameters:
* $1 – the username
kpiidaccounts-error-no-such-user:
Error: there is no account with this name.

Parameters:
* $1 – the name as typed
kpiidaccounts-error-email:
Error: the email address is not valid.

Parameters:
* $1 – the address
kpiidaccounts-error-linked:
Error: the account already has another EMPLOYEE_ID.

Parameters:
* $1 – the username
* $2 – its EMPLOYEE_ID
kpiidaccounts-error-not-linked:
Error: the account has no EMPLOYEE_ID to remove.

Parameters:
* $1 – the username
kpiidaccounts-error-own-account: Error: an administrator tried to remove the link of their own account.
